item.title: Lubbock County Sheriff's Office releases statement on investigations
item.description: The Lubbock County Sheriff's Office released a statement intended to clear misconceptions about their investigations seen on social media.

item.title: Eugene Roquemore display added to Lubbock History Makers during Black History Month
item.description: The City of Lubbock's Communications & Public Engagement has added a new Lubbock History Makers art display at Citizens Tower in honor of Lubbock's very own Eugene Roquemore.

item.title: FBI reviewing new message tied to Nancy Guthrie's apparent abduction
item.description: Tucson TV station KOLD said on Friday it received a new message, via email, tied to the Guthrie case. The station said it couldn’t disclose its contents.

item.title: Texas Tech softball goes perfect at McNeese Tournament
item.description: Three games, three run-rule victories for No. 1 Texas Tech softball. The Red Raiders picked up where they left off last season and demolished their opening slate.

item.title: Lubbock's weekend lineup packed with art, live music and love
